name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: 50 gp goes with at least one of Kael, Hawk, or Rat.
Between Mara and Sable, one goes with Owl and the other with 50 gp.
Owl goes with none of Kael, 40 gp, or 70 gp.
Mara's gold is lower than both Sable and the adventurer with the Rat familiar.
If Mara goes with Hawk, then Cat goes with Kael.

chain: Start by assuming Sable goes with 70 gp.
Sable goes with 70 gp, so it can't also go with 50 gp.

So Sable does not go with 70 gp.
